shortDescription: Adds a selectable Kallax cosmetic body to OMW Storageborn Xenotype and makes Storageborn generation use only this pack's enabled Kallax pool when loaded.
body:
## Kallax cosmetic body

Requires OMW Storageborn Xenotype. Adds an IKEA/Kallax cosmetic body gene and uses the existing Kallax body texture ported into this pack.

## Settings

Provides a settings menu with a Kallax enable/disable option. Disabling Kallax fully removes it from this pack's generation pool; if it is the only enabled option, no new Storageborn body is selected rather than falling back to another pool.

## Spawn-pool override

When this pack is loaded, Storageborn body randomization is Harmony-patched so Storageborn pawns select only from this pack's enabled Kallax pool. The patch is guarded for the base mod and does not alter unrelated xenotypes.
